question: An object is placed on the principal axis of a concave lens, at a point between infinity and its optical centre O. Its image formed is ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Virtual and Diminished.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **When an object is between the lens's infinity and optical centre, a diminished, virtual, and upright picture is created between the focus and centre of the lens.**
 
• A **convex lens **is one that **has a refracting surface on the inside,** while a **concave lens**, also known as a diverging lens, **has a refracting surface on the outside**.
 
 
• **Concave lenses are sometimes known as diverging lenses** because they diverge light beams.
 
 
 
• A lens is a transparent, curved surface that bends light such that it creates an image of whatever is in front of it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Positions of the object and image:**

 
 

 **Position of the object**
 **Position of the Image**
 **The relative size of the image **
 **Nature of the image**
 
 

 **1. At infinity**
 At focus F₁
 Highly diminished, point-sized
 Virtual and erect.
 
 

 **2. Between infinity and optical centre O of the lens**
 Between focus F₁ and optical centre O
 Diminished
 Virtual and erect.
